answer: Shared resource contention proof. Each identity must periodically solve a compute puzzle on the same physical device, and the registry records device-level contention counters (cache evictions, memory bus saturation) that no operator can fabricate without actually running the work. A lantern of pending puzzles must be completed under a gale of randomized parallel load, and the measured contention must match a genuine river of sequential effort. Faking N identities requires N real device-seconds of contention, so attacker cost scales linearly with sybil count and cannot be amortized.
